## Reuters confirms Samsung and SK Hynix sign $950B chip supply partnership with US big tech

Reuters confirmation elevates the $950B figure from reported to fact; the omission of named US buyers leaves open which hyperscalers and chipmakers bear the supply commitment — buyer identity is the key outstanding variable for assessing the portfolio impact across hyperscaler and accelerator holdings.

- Reuters has confirmed the formal signing of approximately $950 billion in partnership agreements between Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and unnamed US big-technology companies.
- The Reuters confirmation upgrades earlier reports from 'set to announce' status to executed and signed agreements.
- Specific US buyer names are not disclosed in any of the Reuters-sourced headlines in this cluster.
- Coverage across Reuters, The Economic Times, TradingView, and Yahoo Finance indicates high and broad market visibility for the confirmed signing.
